jobs.title: Bank Teller - Paris
jobs.description:
First Neighbor Bank is an employee-owned, community-oriented company that offers a fun, family-focused atmosphere, great company culture and an excellent benefits package!

Are you looking to embark on a rewarding career in banking? Join our team at First Neighbor Bank as a Bank Teller! As a Teller, you will have the opportunity to interact with customers daily, providing top-notch service and building strong relationships within the community. This role is perfect for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy helping others with their financial needs. You will be offered great benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Competitive Salary, Paid Time Off, Employee Discounts, and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan. With a competitive pay rate of $16-$18 per hour, this position offers a fantastic opportunity to kickstart your career in banking.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


	Processes deposits, withdraws, and loan payments using teller proof capture systems; corrects misread items and balances/closes transaction batches; issues receipts after verification of amounts, signatures and/or balances.
	Balances currency and coins in cash drawer; buys and sells cash to vault to control volume.
	Promotes bank's e-services, such as online banking, mobile deposits and e-statements; sells bank products such as money orders and safety deposit boxes; makes referrals to First Neighbor’s investment centers and tax and accounting offices. 
	Processes and balances electric utility payments, license sticker sales, coin counter, ATM cash and transactions, and credit card cash advances.
	Assists with customer inquiries concerning transactions and account information; will involve the CSR Supervisor if second-level support is needed. 
	Refers customers to CSRs for new account opening or changes to existing accounts.
	Answers the phone and transfers calls appropriately; processes phone transactions.


 
QualificationsQualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and /or ability required.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Education and/or Experience
Associates Degree preferred; one year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  Successful completion of First Neighbor on line training.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Demonstrates accuracy in the handling of cash, making financial transactions, and balancing of cash drawer. Highly proficient in practical math skills. Displays mental alertness, a professional appearance, punctuality, cooperativeness, and strong service minded attitude. Uses effective customer service and sales skills. Communicates clearly and concisely in ways that are easy to understand, verbally and in writing. Makes quick smooth transitions from one task to another. Adept in operating computers and proficient in software applications for Microsoft Windows, Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point, internet and related computer platforms.   Able to operate First Neighbor business equipment including but not limited to calculators, copying equipment, telephone systems, checking imaging technology, document scanners, shredders, coin machines, and cash counters.

jobs.title: Financial Advisor
jobs.description:
About Us
At First Neighbor Bank, we've been serving our community for generations with a commitment to personalized service and trusted financial guidance. As a community bank, we believe that strong relationships are the foundation of financial success-for our clients, our employees, and our community.

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced and client-focused Financial Advisor to join our team. This role is dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses in our community build and preserve wealth through sound financial planning and investment strategies. The right candidate will be someone who values long-term relationships over transactions and takes pride in guiding clients with integrity and care.

Key Responsibilities


	
	Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with clients.
	
	
	Provide investment advice and financial planning tailored to each client's goals and values.
	
	
	Conduct regular portfolio reviews and make appropriate recommendations.
	
	
	Educate clients on financial strategies in a way that is approachable and easy to understand.
	
	
	Collaborate with other bank departments to ensure clients receive well-rounded financial solutions.
	
	
	Stay current with market trends, regulatory requirements, and investment products.
	


What We Offer


	
	Competitive salary range of $50,000-$80,000 with performance-based incentives.
	
	
	Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, and retirement plans.
	
	Employee Owned Stock Program
	
	Opportunities for professional growth and continuing education.
	
	
	A supportive, team-oriented environment where your work makes a difference in the community.
	


 

At First Neighbor Bank, you'll have the opportunity to do meaningful work while building lasting relationships in the community you call home.
Qualifications
	
	Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or a related field (advanced credentials such as CFP®, ChFC®, or CFA® preferred).
	
	
	FINRA licensing (Series 7, 63, and/or 65/66) or ability to obtain within a designated timeframe.
	
	
	Minimum of 2 years of experience in financial advising, investment management, or wealth planning.
	
	
	Strong knowledge of investments, retirement planning, and risk management.
	
	
	Excellent listening, communication, and relationship-building skills.
	
	
	Commitment to serving clients with integrity and putting their needs first.

jobs.title: PC Support Technician
jobs.description:
At First Neighbor Bank, we believe great technology support is about more than fixing computers. It's about helping people do their best work so they can provide exceptional service to our customers and communities.

We're looking for a PC Support Technician who enjoys solving problems, helping others, and learning new technologies. In this role, you'll be a key member of our Information Technology team, providing hands-on support to associates across our organization. From troubleshooting hardware and software issues to supporting Microsoft 365 applications and technology projects, you'll play an important role in keeping our team connected, productive, and secure.

Whether you're an experienced support professional or an emerging IT talent with a strong technical aptitude and a desire to learn, this is an opportunity to build your skills, make a meaningful impact, and grow your career with a community bank that values teamwork, service, and employee ownership. Some travel to First Neighbor Bank locations will be required as you help support our branch and corporate teams throughout the organization.
QualificationsResponsibilities


	Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for desktops, laptops, monitors, printers, scanners, docking stations, phones, mobile devices, and other end-user technology.
	Troubleshoot Windows operating system, hardware, software, connectivity, and peripheral issues.
	Install, configure, deploy, replace, and maintain computers and related equipment.
	Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding, including workstation preparation and account/access-related tasks.
	Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
	Assist with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot device enrollment and deployment.
	Assist with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory user and device administration.
	Support multi-factor authentication, password resets, account lockouts, and basic identity/access issues.
	Maintain accurate records of computers, peripherals, software, and other technology assets.
	Document incidents and service requests within the Bank's IT ticketing system and ensure tickets are properly updated, escalated, and resolved.
	Work with third-party technology providers when escalation or vendor support is required.
	Assist with workstation refreshes, hardware upgrades, software deployments, branch projects, and other IT initiatives.
	Perform basic network troubleshooting involving connectivity, cabling, switches, wireless connectivity, and IP configuration.
	Follow established cybersecurity, information security, change management, and technology policies.
	Create and maintain basic technical documentation and end-user instructions.
	Provide professional, courteous, and responsive support to employees at all levels of the organization.
	Perform other technology-related duties and projects as assigned.


Education and Experience


	Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred; equivalent technical experience will be considered.
	One to three years of desktop support, help desk, PC technician, or similar technology support experience preferred.
	Entry-level candidates with strong technical aptitude, relevant education, certifications, internships, or hands-on technical experience are encouraged to apply.
	Previous experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry is beneficial but not required.
	Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator, or similar credentials are beneficial but not required.


Skills and Abilities


	Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to communicate technical concepts in understandable terms.
	A positive, solutions-oriented approach to technology support.
	Strong organizational and time-management skills.
	Ability to prioritize multiple support requests and projects.
	Attention to detail and accurate documentation.
	Ability to work independently while also contributing as part of an IT team.
	Willingness to learn new technologies and expand technical knowledge.
	Professionalism when working with confidential or sensitive information.
	Understanding of the importance of security within a financial institution.
	Ability to recognize when an issue should be escalated.


The primary work location for this position will be Toledo, Illinois. Periodic travel to other First Neighbor Bank locations will be required to provide onsite technical support, deploy or replace equipment, assist with technology projects, troubleshoot branch issues, and support other operational needs. A valid driver's license and the ability to travel between Bank locations are required.

jobs.title: Member Assist Cart Attendant
jobs.description:
Position Summary…
We are looking for people who take pride in their work to join our team. You help shape our member’s entire shopping experience by giving them a positive first and last impression.
In the member assist – cart attendant role, you are responsible for ensuring members see a well-kept parking lot which includes helping members with their purchases, and ensure there are carts ready and available. You will also assist our members helping them load their vehicles and support creating a great member experience. This means you are constantly on your feet and on the go. Rain or shine, sleet or snow, our members count on you.
You will sweep us off our feet if:
- You thrive in fast-paced environments
- You’re a multi-tasker at heart
- You keep member satisfaction as your top priority
- You can stand for long periods of time while assisting members quickly and accurately
- You’re a problem solver who tackles obstacles head-on to ensure each task is completed with excellence
You will make an impact by:
- Maintaining a positive attitude by smiling, greeting and thanking members
- Providing exceptional customer service to members across the club as needed, answering any questions they may have
- Maintaining a clean, neat, and member-ready area
The member assistant – cart attendant is a great way to start a fulfilling career at Sam’s Club. Apply now!
The above information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed in the role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. The full job description can be made available as part of the hiring process.
What you’ll do…
Ensures club pick up orders are filled by contacting members to notify when pickup time is delayed; informing members when products are unavailable (for example, out of stock); offering members alternative product options when needed; ensuring products are selected and packaged according to company policies and procedures; ensuring items are dispensed when members arrive for pickup; resolving member issues and concerns; and promoting the company’s products and services.
Maintains safety of facility according to company policies and procedures by conducting safety sweeps; following procedures for handling merchandise; and correcting and reporting unsafe situations to facility management.
Provides member service by acknowledging the member and identifying member needs; assisting members with purchasing decisions; processing member purchases; assisting with payments according to company policies and procedures for different membership and payment types; utilizing cash registers to assist members with transactions; locating and organizing merchandise; zoning the designated areas; resolving member issues and concerns; promoting the company’s products and services; organizing and maintaining availability of carts/flatbeds; assisting members with transporting items; utilizing cart retrieval equipment according to company policies and procedures; and maintaining parking lot cleanliness.
Complies with company policies, procedures, and standards of ethics and integrity by implementing related action plans; using the Open Door Policy; and applying these in executing business processes and practices.
Completes work assignments and priorities by using policies, data, and resources; collaborating with managers, co-workers, customers, and other business partners; identifying priorities, deadlines, and expectations; carrying out tasks; communicating progress and information; determining and recommending ways to address improvement opportunities; and adapting to and learning from change, difficulties, and feedback.
At Sam’s Club, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet!
-Health benefits  include medical, vision and dental coverage
-Financial benefits  include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance
-Paid time off benefits  include PTO, parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see  https://one.walmart.com/notices .
- Other benefits  include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more.
Live Better U is a company paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam’s Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor’s degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
